Dorothy is an [[Illusia]] from the Somnoire, frequently appearing in [[Depths of Illusive Realm]] events. Her identity or role as an Illusia, is often taken by others when interacting with Rover<ref>[[Fairy Tale's Finale]]</ref><ref>[[If You Gaze Into the Abyss of Dreams]]</ref>. 

It is assumed as one point, [[D]] who assumed Dorothy identity once, based off her behavior, in the event <ref>[[Depths of Illusive Realm: Chromatic Fantasy]]</ref><ref>[[Depths of Illusive Realm: Dreamchasers]]</ref>.

According to Ebony Gatekeeper, it is confirmed Dorothy is an actual person, who is very kind and would never lie- which makes it easy for those assuming her identity to be ousted. 

==Speculations==
* Dorothy is speculated to be one of the residence living within the Somnoire. 
* It is speculated [[Ebony Gatekeeper]] took on Dorothy appearance in the event, [[Fairy Tale's Finale/Story|Fairy Tale's Finale]].
* It is speculated [[D]] took on Dorothy roles in the event, [[Depths of Illusive Realm: Chromatic Fantasy]] and [[Depths of Illusive Realm: Dreamchasers]].
